messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the person in the video with the person shown in the reference photo. Use the reference photo only to determine the target person's facial identity and skin tone. Apply that skin tone consistently to the face and body, while retaining the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the person in the video with the person shown in the reference photo. Only use the reference photo to determine the target person's facial identity and skin tone. Apply that skin tone consistently to the face and body, while retaining the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The woman faces the camera, then turns her head to her left and raises her right hand in a brief gesture before turning back to face forward.","camera":"A static, eye-level medium close-up shot that keeps the woman centered in the frame.","clothing":"A bright pink, off-the-shoulder top with a V-shaped neckline and purple straps visible at the shoulders.","hair_color":"White.","hairstyle":"A white bob with straight bangs and two small, rounded pigtails tied at the sides of her head.","identity":"A 3D-rendered woman with dark brown skin, a slender build, and a neutral-to-smiling facial expression.","scene":"An outdoor, sunlit area with a stone-paved ground, an overturned wooden boat on the left, and scattered wooden planks and crates in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The woman's face and visible body skin became noticeably darker and more uniformly deep brown, matching the reference skin tone better than the source. Her white bob, bangs, pigtails, pink top, pose, gestures, scene, and static camera remained essentially the same.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the person's facial identity and skin tone with the reference person, applying the reference skin tone consistently to face and body while retaining hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera.
uncertain: Whether the facial identity now matches the reference photo closely enough, since the reference face is not fully visible in the output.
unexpected_changes: Facial features appear somewhat altered beyond skin tone, though the overall identity remains similar to the source character.
